How did each month go, and how many months of cash do we have left at the current burn? Prepare what the CFO needs to present. Record the key figures in {WS}/result.json: revenue, gross_margin_pct and ebitda, each mapping 2026-01 to 2026-06 to its value, plus burn and runway_months.

[goal] Close the first half of 2026 for the investor meeting.

[action] Prepared the [CFO briefing](<WORKSPACE>/CFO_briefing.md) and recorded the requested figures in [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json).

[result] Revenue rose from R$ 200,510.87 in January to R$ 272,391.57 in June. June had the strongest gross margin, 72.41%, and the smallest EBITDA loss, R$ 192,968.22. Using the board’s definition, monthly burn is **R$ 197,288.23** and runway is **9.36 months** from the June closing cash balance of R$ 1,847,350.40.

The figures were calculated from the ledger and account mappings. The runway follows the board’s stated formula; it assumes the recent EBITDA burn remains representative. Cash fell R$ 461,837.60 in June, substantially more than the EBITDA loss, and the supplied records do not explain the difference.

[next] Reconcile the June cash movement before using the runway as a cash-flow forecast.

# First half 2026: CFO briefing

All amounts in Brazilian reais (R$). Revenue is net of refunds. Parentheses indicate losses.

| Month | Revenue | Gross margin | EBITDA |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| January | 200,510.87 | 70.03% | (210,278.96) |
| February | 216,328.06 | 70.29% | (212,300.08) |
| March | 219,066.17 | 68.46% | (204,525.45) |
| April | 238,163.26 | 70.24% | (196,950.65) |
| May | 243,032.89 | 69.56% | (201,945.82) |
| June | 272,391.57 | 72.41% | (192,968.22) |

Revenue rose 35.85% from January to June. February's EBITDA loss widened despite revenue growth; March's margin fell to 68.46%, including a R$ 6,814.15 refund. April improved on both margin and EBITDA; May's loss widened again and includes a R$ 8,634.37 refund. June delivered the highest revenue and margin and the smallest EBITDA loss of the half. Half-year revenue was R$ 1,389,492.82 and EBITDA was a loss of R$ 1,218,969.18.

## Cash and runway

- Closing cash at 30 June: R$ 1,847,350.40.
- Board-defined burn: average monthly EBITDA loss for April to June = (196,950.65 + 201,945.82 + 192,968.22) / 3 = R$ 197,288.23 per month.
- Runway: 1,847,350.40 / 197,288.23 = 9.36 months from 30 June, assuming that burn and cash remain representative and no financing or other cash movements occur.
- Cash fell R$ 461,837.60 from 31 May to 30 June, R$ 268,869.38 more than June's EBITDA loss. EBITDA is not cash flow; the supplied records do not explain this difference. Investigate working capital, capital spending, financing and other cash movements before relying on runway as a cash forecast.

## Basis and checks

The ledger is grouped by transaction month and account using the supplied chart of accounts. Gross profit equals net revenue plus signed COGS; gross margin is gross profit divided by net revenue. EBITDA equals gross profit plus signed sales and marketing, R&D and G&A expenses. Financial income and interest are excluded. No depreciation or amortization accounts are identified in the supplied chart; the operating result is treated as EBITDA on that basis. The board's definition and the latest cash balance come from finance/README.md and finance/cash_balance.txt. This is a calculation from the supplied ledger, not evidence that accruals, completeness or the cash bridge have been independently verified.
